response.sql: WITH buckets AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS bucket_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), shares AS (SELECT bucket_count, bucket_count::numeric / SUM(bucket_count) OVER () AS share FROM buckets), compared AS (SELECT bucket_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bucket_count), 0) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;
